name: testflow-desktop
description: TestFlow TCM — Enterprise Test Case Management Desktop App

scripts.build:backend-bundle: cd ../backend && npm run build && cd ../electron && node_modules/.bin/ncc build ../backend/dist/main.js -o resources/backend -m --no-source-map-register
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder && npm run copy:readme
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run copy:readme
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac && npm run copy:readme
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux && npm run copy:readme
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && electron-builder -mwl && npm run copy:readme
